note: BR1 battle royale (src/royale.cpp). Players: ScenarioRules royalePlayers (setup UI, 10..100, default 30). Storm circles 1..3 are radiusFrac x the play area's shorter side; circle 4 is finalRadius_m (BR7: 25 m), which then drifts: driftPause_s, then a driftMove_s glide of driftMin_m..driftMax_m; each centre is random inside the previous circle. Storm damage ignores armor (Game::damage how = storm).

vehicles.note: BR7: parked civilian cars (sedan, SUV, pickup, hatchback, van) on open ground made drivable at the start; bots do not drive
